d:
Enjoy “Yaava Kaviyu Bareyalaara”, A Beautiful Kannada Song From The Classic Movie Bhagyada Lakshmi Baramma, Featuring Dr. Rajkumar And Madhavi.
Relive The Golden Era Of Kannada Cinema With This Evergreen Melody. Celebrate The Magic Of Kannada Old Songs And Enjoy The Nostalgic Charm Of This Lyrical Song.
Kannada Old Songs, Lyrical Songs, And Evergreen Melodies.
Movie: Bhagyada Lakshmi Baramma
Directed by: Singeetham Srinivasa Rao
Produced by: Parvathamma Rajkumar
Artist Name: Rajkumar, Madhavi, K. S. Ashwath, Thoogudeepa Srinivas
Music Director: Singeetham Srinivasa Rao
